record.paper_title: Bayesian predictive densities for linear regression models under α-divergence loss: some results and open problems
record.context_brief: Analogue of KL risk-reduction identity for general α
record.original_question: For predictive density estimation under α-divergence loss D_α with |α| < 1 in the canonical normal model, is there an identity or structural relationship analogous to the one George, Liang, and Xu (2006) used for Kullback-Leibler loss, namely a relationship linking predictive-risk reduction to the risk-reduction theory for estimating a multivariate normal mean vector?

evidence.quote: George, Liang and Xu (2006) used some techniques including the heat equation and Stein’s identity, and eventually found a new identity which links KL risk reduction to Stein’s unbiased estimate of risk reduction.

Hence we expect that there should exist an analogous relationship between the prediction problem under the Dα loss for |α| < 1 and the problem of estimating the mean vector. As far as we know, this is still an open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $X \mid \mu \sim N_d(\mu, v_x I_d)$ and $Y \mid \mu \sim N_d(\mu, v_y I_d)$ be independent $d$-dimensional Gaussian vectors with common unknown mean $\mu \in \mathbb{R}^d$ and known variances $v_x, v_y > 0$. Let $p(y \mid \mu)$ denote the true sampling density of $Y$. For a candidate predictive density $\hat p(y; X)$ of $Y$ based on $X$, and for $\alpha \in (-1,1)$, define the $\alpha$-divergence loss
$$D_\alpha(p(\cdot\mid\mu),\hat p(\cdot;X)) = \frac{4}{1-\alpha^2}\left(1 - \int p(y\mid\mu)^{(1-\alpha)/2}\,\hat p(y;X)^{(1+\alpha)/2}\,dy\right),$$
and the corresponding $\alpha$-risk $R_\alpha(\mu,\hat p) = E_{X\mid\mu}[D_\alpha(p(\cdot\mid\mu),\hat p(\cdot;X))]$. For the Kullback–Leibler limit $\alpha \to -1$, it is known (via heat-equation and Stein-identity techniques) that for the Bayes predictive density $\hat p_\pi$ associated with a prior $\pi$, the difference $R_{KL}(\mu,\hat p_{\pi_U}) - R_{KL}(\mu,\hat p_\pi)$ between the risk under the uniform prior $\pi_U$ and the risk under $\pi$ can be expressed as an integrated risk difference for estimating the mean $\mu$ of a multivariate normal observation under quadratic loss; this identity links predictive risk reduction to Stein's unbiased estimate of risk reduction for normal mean estimation.

Question. For $|\alpha|<1$, does there exist an analogous identity expressing the $\alpha$-divergence predictive risk reduction $R_\alpha(\mu,\hat p_{\pi_U}) - R_\alpha(\mu,\hat p_\pi)$ in terms of the risk-reduction theory for estimating the mean $\mu$ of a multivariate normal vector under (a suitable) quadratic-type loss, paralleling the Kullback–Leibler case?
artifact.category_tag: Bayesian predictive density estimation under α-divergence
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work by Maruyama–Strawderman, Boisbunon–Maruyama, and L'Moudden–Marchand has produced minimaxity and dominance results for predictive densities under α-divergence loss with |α|<1, but no source clearly establishes a full identity linking α-divergence predictive risk reduction to Stein-type unbiased estimates of risk reduction for multivariate normal mean estimation in the manner of George–Liang–Xu (2006). Status appears unresolved in the literature accessible online.

status_evidence.title: On Predictive Density Estimation under α-Divergence Loss
status_evidence.snippet: Studies efficiency of predictive densities under α-divergence loss for normal models.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses α-divergence predictive density estimation but does not state the identity in question.

status_evidence.title: Optimal Shrinkage Estimation of Predictive Densities Under α-Divergences
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses α-divergences and references the George-Liang-Xu KL identity but does not establish the analogous identity for general |α|<1.
status_evidence.claim: No analogous identity is explicitly developed in this paper.

status_evidence.title: From Minimax Shrinkage Estimation to Minimax Shrinkage Prediction
status_evidence.snippet: George, Liang and Xu drew parallels between KL risk and quadratic risk problems via unbiased estimates of risk.
status_evidence.claim: The identity is known for KL (α=-1); the general |α|<1 analogue remains the motivating open question.
